body:
What Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in NYC?

A full bathroom renovation in New York City typically costs between $14,000 and $90,000 in 2026. The most common project — a full gut of a standard 5x8 bathroom with mid-range finishes — lands between $35,000 and $55,000.

Demolition and debris: $2,000-$4,000. Plumbing: $4,000-$12,000 (DOB permitted). Waterproofing: $1,500-$3,000 (Schluter KERDI or RedGard). Tile: $4,000-$15,000 (floor DCOF ≥ 0.42). Electrical: $2,000-$5,000 (GFCI, exhaust, EMT conduit). Vanity and fixtures: $3,000-$15,000.

What Drives Cost Up?

Three factors: moving plumbing (cutting concrete, rerouting drains), building logistics (co-op elevator scheduling, work hour restrictions), and finish level ($10/sqft porcelain vs. $35/sqft marble across 200 sqft = $5,000 difference in material alone).
